title: CentoAI
tagline: An AI-powered DeFi portfolio manager optimizing yield farming & flash loan arbitrage across Aave, Compound, and Uniswap V3. Built with Coinbase AgentKit, Privy, and deployed on Base for max returns.
description:
CentoAI is an AI-powered DeFi portfolio manager designed to optimize yield farming and flash loan arbitrage across top DeFi protocols. It dynamically reallocates funds to the highest-yielding opportunities, executes risk-free arbitrage strategies, and provides users with a seamless, automated DeFi experience.

The AI agent continuously monitors real-time APY data from Aave, Compound, and Uniswap V3, using machine learning models to identify the best yield farming opportunities. It leverages Balancer V2 flash loans to execute risk-free arbitrage strategies.

CentoAI supports Aave, Compound, Uniswap V3, and Balancer V2, allowing users to access a wide range of DeFi opportunities. Each user gets a personalized vault to deposit funds and set strategies, with a user-friendly dashboard to monitor portfolio performance and strategy execution.

CentoAI uses Coinbase AgentKit to automate fund movements and strategy execution, and Privy to enable seamless onboarding via embedded wallets and social logins. The project is deployed on Base and Arbitrum for low-cost, high-speed transactions.
how_its_made: CentoAI is built using a modular architecture, combining smart contracts (Solidity), a Next.js frontend, and a Node.js backend. The AI agent analyzes yield opportunities and executes strategies using Coinbase AgentKit. Key integrations include Aave, Compound, Uniswap V3, and Balancer V2 for yield farming and arbitrage. The project is deployed on Base and Arbitrum for low-cost, high-speed transactions. Highlights include a custom flash loan arbitrage system, multi-chain deployment, and AI-driven strategy execution. The smart contracts are optimized for gas efficiency using Foundry’s gas profiling tools, reducing transaction costs for users. The frontend, built with Next.js and OnchainKit and integrates Privy for embedded wallets and social logins, enabling users to onboard with email or existing wallets. This provides a user-friendly dashboard for monitoring portfolio performance and strategy execution. The backend fetches real-time APY data from DeFi protocols and provides it to the AI agent, which uses machine learning models to analyze opportunities and execute strategies in real-time.
